# JobPulse AI Agent

> An AI job-search command centre that lives inside Claude Code: it searches 8 job boards, tailors resumes, writes cover letters, researches companies, and assists with browser-based applications.

JobPulse is a Claude Code plugin for people running a real job search. One slash command runs the whole loop: onboarding, deep search across Indeed / LinkedIn / Glassdoor / ZipRecruiter / Google / Bayt / Naukri / BDJobs, resume review or build, per-role company research, resume customization against each JD, a targeted cover letter, interview prep, and optional browser-assisted apply. All data stays local in a `job-search/` folder in the user's working directory — there is no cloud account, no API key, no telemetry.

## What it does

- Searches 8 job boards in parallel with one call (`search_jobs_batch`), returning deduped, salary-normalised results.
- Reviews an existing resume or builds one from the user's files, with a base-practice and formatting reference library.
- Produces a per-company research brief (values, red/green flags, "Resume Customization Notes").
- Tailors the base resume per job posting — reorder and keyword-match only, never fabricates experience.
- Drafts a 3-paragraph, 200–280-word cover letter grounded in the research brief.
- Generates STAR-outline interview questions and company-specific questions to ask back.
- Optionally fills the application form in the user's browser, one field at a time, never auto-submitting.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add JCodesMore/jcodesmore-plugins
/plugin install jobs-for-ai-agents@jcodesmore-plugins
```

Restart Claude Code, then run `/findmeajob`.

Requires Claude Code, Python ≥ 3.10, Node.js ≥ 18. No accounts, no API keys. Dependencies install automatically on first run.

## Entry points

- `/findmeajob` — the full workflow (onboarding → search → research → tailoring → packages).
- `/apply` — browser-assisted form fill; always asks before submitting.
- `/setup` — view or edit preferences, reset data, manage resumes.
- `/agent-seo` — ship the AI-agent-detectable SEO bundle for any site or product (llms.txt, agents.json, JSON-LD, robots.txt, sitemap.xml). Runs standalone against any directory.

- License: Apache-2.0
> A Claude Code plugin that runs the whole job search on your own machine. Searches 8 job boards via JobSpy, builds a company research brief, customizes your resume per posting, writes a cover letter, preps interviews, drafts salary counter-offers, optimizes your LinkedIn, and — with explicit confirmation — fills out application forms in your browser. No API keys, no telemetry, no cloud sync.

This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/) so LLM-powered search tools can map the repository quickly and cite accurate, file-level sources.

The single most important file to ground any factual claim is [`FACTS.md`](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/FACTS.md) — every public claim about JobPulse is mapped there to the code or doc that proves it.

## Core docs

- [README](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/README.md): what JobPulse is, quick start, user-facing feature summary.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/AGENTS.md): machine-readable map of the plugin — MCP tools, skills, agents, data layout, typical flow.
- [BLUEPRINT.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/BLUEPRINT.md): production architecture, file map, MCP tool reference, release notes.

- [INTEGRATE.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/INTEGRATE.md): how other agents, SDKs, apps, and CI call the MCP server.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): version history.

## MCP server

- [mcp/job_server.py](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/mcp/job_server.py): the MCP server. Five tools: `search_jobs`, `search_jobs_batch`, `get_supported_sites`, `get_supported_countries`, `get_search_tips`. Backed by [JobSpy](https://github.com/speedyapply/JobSpy).
- [mcp/requirements.txt](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/mcp/requirements.txt): three runtime Python deps — `mcp`, `python-jobspy`, `pandas`.
- [mcp/test_server.py](https://github.com/dnzengou/jobpulse-ai-agent/blob/main/mcp/test_server.py): offline smoke tests (no network).
